verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs directly claim agents can 'safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments.' This is backed by sandbox-specific API endpoints for setup commands and sandbox log analysis, which confirm the agent runs inside a provisioned sandbox. Missing for 10: technical detail on the isolation mechanism (container/VM, network and secret boundaries), in-depth sandbox configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox

citations.quote: Safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments
This endpoint creates an AI agent that will analyze the setup logs from a sandbox,
The agent will analyze the repository structure and generate appropriate setup commands.
